title: Purpose
coreMove: Purpose motivates when profit is paired with contribution, daily choices, and goals that connect work to something beyond status.

exampleSpecs.audience: Ilya, a board member deciding whether money follows the mission
exampleSpecs.stakes: A nonprofit claims community health as its purpose while shifting money away from outreach.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show purpose being tested by a budget tradeoff.

exampleSpecs.audience: Seren, a charge nurse connecting a huddle to patient purpose
exampleSpecs.stakes: A hospital shift risks becoming only a throughput conversation.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the Mayo Clinic lesson as a daily decision rule.

exampleSpecs.audience: Bruno, a launch lead deciding whether contribution is built in
exampleSpecs.stakes: A shoe company can add charity after the sale or design contribution into the model.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show TOMS as an operating-logic lesson, not a marketing label.

exampleSpecs.audience: Cassia, a coach helping a client define contribution
exampleSpecs.stakes: A career plan is drifting toward status goals without a beneficiary.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use life-goal research to make purpose concrete.

exampleSpecs.audience: Leif, a benefits-committee member testing whom the policy serves
exampleSpecs.stakes: A benefits proposal protects the spreadsheet while claiming to support people.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show purpose being checked against the people named by it.

exampleSpecs.audience: Noor, a civic designer making public contribution visible
exampleSpecs.stakes: A city service redesign needs a purpose residents can see.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Translate purpose into a public proof point.
